content: Manqat ndøgo, khandi nqani-etoam, qamø-ezoqam-evNqanek Manqat, Yesu Kelisó
Ibugukhokhof, manqei-qape khakheinøpøteav qagoam, Manqat ndøgo, oskia ndøgoám. Nqanek Manqat Mbumbukiám namba me꞉goám, neka ndøgo Mbumbukiám.
Ngenek ezoqam, ngenek Manqat nqago, ndego Mbumbukiam namba oskia ndøgoám, ibugukhokhof, atema ndakin.
Mbumbukiam gigiap ate nqægo, te mokho-té genø-khakheinumát. Gigiap kopo mbaín, ndego te mokho-te khakheinøpøteav qagoam.
Te mokho-te, khandi ndøgoám. Neka nqanek khandi, ezoqam-qá wáev.
Nqanek waev bøivun-té qanuwaév. Yaq bøivun, kopømba mbaín, nqanek waev vǿe-khoutāv.
Yaq ezoqa ndowáv. Mbumbukiam ndokhofotáv. Teqa iz Zión.
Ndego ezoqa zømesim-qa ndøgeavún. Waev-qá yaq-té gené-zømesím. Yaq te mokho-te ndego, ezoqa ewaqape, tìabiti-unimanqatiním.
Zion ndego ekezan, wáev mbá. Ndego ezoqa waev-qa yaq-te zømesim-qa mba ndøgeavún.
Ta waev ndøgo, unimanqatin wáev. Ezoqa ewaqape-té qanøwá. Nqanek waev, manqei-qape-té qanøfakhán.
Ngenek ezoqam, ndego Manqat ndøgo, ndego manqei-qape-té gegoám. Ta manqei-qape, te mokho-té qando-fakhán. Geté manqei-qape ezoqam, gèbi꞉nám.
Ndego ekeza ezoqam-té genøgeavún. Geté ndigu khatoweáv.
Geté gekha ezoqām ndigu, gikhatowem neka ndego vø̄-unimanqatinim, ndego iz zø-etoám. Ndigu kopømbá, gemø-Mbumbukiam-gí-nakheis-éz.
Nginik ambá av nqǣgo, evøndipakha-qā kouk-tē o kha-qā poev-tē o zivis-qā poev-tē ginøqāz. Geté Mbumbukiam mokho-té ginøqáz.

Nqanek Manqat gèmø-ezoqam-év, ni namba vizimīyag. Ni teqa bazaføgakh neka waev mø̀iqeivím. Ndøgo Yo kopo-qá bazaføgákh neka wáev. Eve-té qandowáv. Te mokho-te, kuku matev neka unimanqatin manqat, mø̀ndømø-tøvá.

Zion ndégo tene-manqatám. Teqa yaq-te, ndego āv gene-akhá nqǽgo, “Ezoqam ngének, no qate-manqatam av nqægo: Ndego ezoqam, noqa zita-te tegeav, ndego no ùnime꞉-løvumbám. Zapa ndǿgo, no qaneav qagoam, ndego até gegoám.”
Teqa kuku matev-te, te mokho-te qamu-tøva, ni ezoqa ate nqazi꞉gu, kuku matev oskia zi-upøgimatún, miavmiav.
Mozes mokho-te, Mbumbukiam guguna manqat ni-etoám. Geté Yesu Keliso mokho-te, kuku matev neka unimanqatin manqat ndofakhán, ni-te.
Ezoqa kopo Mbumbukiam ometeáv. Geté tege Yo kopo, ndego ekezán, Mbumbukiám. Neka ndego Evé namba me꞉yagé. Ngének, gini-ovøyám, teqa yaq-te.
Zion, ndego ibøkha iz etoam ezoqam, ezoqa Keliso-qa yaq-te ge꞉zømesimam
Zu megetapak, Zelusalem taon-te ndøgo, Mbumbukiam-gi iziz ezoqam neka Livai ezoqam ndøkhofotáz, Zion-te, vømømbō-bevøpem, av nqægo, “Gê, qo gekha ezoqâm?”
Yaq Zion, ndego naopøteáv. Sègezø-eín, “No Mesayá mbá.”

Yaq ndigu gimbo-qavøinam, “Av tægoat ndægo, qo gekha ezoqâm? Ilaizâ?” Yaq Zion gezø-qavøiu, “Mbaín. No Ilaizá mbá.” Yaq gimbo-bevøpem, “Gê, qo Mbumbukiam-gê manqa vevezam ezoqàm, ni nqazimbøe-keoge?” Yaq ndego gendo-qavøiu, “Mbaín. No teoká ndego.”
Yaq ndigu gimbo-einim, “Av tægoat ndægo, yaq qo gekha ezoqâm? Ni qavøiwat manqat batikhæ-ndapém, ni tømizømas, ndigu, ni ma gindi-khofotan. Gê, qo qakezan-qa yaq-te gekhā qoté-manqate?”

Yaq Zion gezø-ein, “No ndégo, ezoqam-qá manqa wág, leg-av manqei-te ndø-akhayam, av nqægo, ‘Evezøza-qa nakhoa é-mozoto-khakheinám.’ Av Aezaya, ndego Mbumbukiam-ge manqa vevezam ezoqam, ge꞉peawam.”
Ti mokho-te ndigu, Zu megetapak gindu-khofotaz, nøme Felisi ezoqám.
Yaq ndigu Zion gimbo-bevøpem, “Qo Mesaya neka Ilaiza neka Mbumbukiam-ge manqa vevezam ezoqam goneav ndoqogo, yaq qo gekha zapâ, ezoqa ibøkha iz ndoqozø-etoam?”
Yaq Zion gendo-qavøiu, “No ezoqa ibøkha iz, ibøkhá qazømbe-etoám. Geté zo mokho-te, ezoqam ngêgó. Zo ndego zø̀tezøtezák.
Ezoqam ndégo, noqa zita-te ngegeav. Ndego no ùnime꞉-løvumbám. No ezoqa khàpe nøte-khapelavøqase-én. Até nqanek sasae khapelavøqasé-a, no teqa tamak khofoe-te tæmbotøke, no kopømba mbaín.”
Nqanek matev, Betani vemiav-té qafakhán. Zoden kea yaq-keoqá, ta manqei ndøgo, Zion ezoqa ibøkha iz gezø-etoumam.
Yesu, ndego Mbumbukiam-gé Sip Nakhasám
Yaq khøuwa nøme qandopave, Zion Yesu ndø-omét. Te-té genømát. Yaq Zion ezoqa āv gezømbe-eín nqǽgo, “Ndé! Mbumbukiam-gé Sip Nakhasám. Ngenek manqei-qape ezoqam-qá manqa-zapazapa ndǿndáp.
Ezoqam ngének, no qate-manqatam av nqægo, ‘Noqa zita-te, ezoqa ndø̀geáv. Ndego no ùnime꞉-løvumbám. Zapa ndǿgo, no qaneav qagoam, ndego até gegoám.’
No bugukhokhof ngenek nøtenateáv. Geté no qægeavun, ezoqam ibøkha iz nqazø-etoam, no nqánek qatøndenáv, Izlael ezoqam gí꞉zøtéz, ezoqam ngének.”

Yaq nqanek matev-qa yaq-te, taqa zita-te qafakhan, Zion ezoqa āv gezømbe-manqatám nqǽgo, “No āv qateqeív nqǽgo: Yan-te nqo꞉go, Nqova Mbomambaqape ndovís. Andé kuvøkuvuam me me꞉løvuvavún, te-te vō꞉qom.

No bugukhokhof nøtenateáv, ndego gekha ezoqām. Geté Mbumbukiam, ndego no gendo-khofotan, ezoqa ibøkha iz tæzø-etoumat, āv genenømánd nqǽgo, ‘Qo ezoqam toqo-omet, Nqova Mbomambaqape te-te ndego tendovis, yaq te-te vó꞉qōm, ezoqam nándev. Ndego ezoqa ibøkha iz, Nqova Mbomambaqape-té genøzǿ-etoumát.’
No mø̀eqeív, nqanek matev. Yaq no nò-unimanqatintét, av nqægo, ndego Mbumbukiam-gé Yó.”
Yesu-gi bugukhokhof paev ezoqam
Yaq khøuwa nøme qandopave, Zion manqei kopo-te ndøgo, nqawá genø-itán. Ekeza paev ezoqa menás namba me꞉goám.
Yaq Zion Yesu ge-omet, gegeavun, ndego āv gene-eín nqǽgo, “Ndé! Mbumbukiam-gé Sip Nakhasám.”
Yaq ndigu Zion-gi paev ezoqa menas, nqanek manqat giyogem, até gindigonem, Yesu vømbō-paevem.

Yaq Yesu gendoqambun, gezømet, gimbopavam, ndego āv gezømbe-beváp nqǽgo, “Zo gekham-qā zóvawet?” Yaq gindu-qavøinam, “Lábai, qo gekham-tē qoqó-qomat?” (Labai, taqa manqa mokho, “Nømendim ezoqám.”)

Yaq gendo-qavøiu, “Zøtøndézāv. Zomǿqeivím.” Yaq ndigu namba me꞉záv, vø̄qeivim, ma ge꞉qotam ndøgo. Ndøgo khagús. Khøuwa iz ande āv 4 oklók ndægó. Yaq ndigu Yesú namba me꞉goát, ate khøuwa vømø̄sinan.
Ndigu ezoqa menas, Zion-qa manqat giyogem, yaq Yesu gimbo-paevem, ezoqa nøme Endlú. Saemon Pita-gé namba qawán.

Endlu Yesu ge-ivav, yaq até gendego, ekeza namba qawan-qa møváo, Saemon, vø̄-omet, gembo-ein, “Ni Mesaya ni-ometám, ndego Mbumbukiam manqa mbusa geve, tendo-khofotav.” (Nqanek manqat, Mesaya, Glik manqat-te, Keliso mbo-akhayám.)
Yaq ndego Yesu-té genø-itú. Yesu Saemon ge-omet, yaq āv gembøe-eín nqǽgo, “Qo Saemon, Zion-ge yo, iz Sifas qá-akhaemát.” (Sifas neka Pita, ndøgo mokho kopó, nandí.)
Yesu Filip neka Natanael gezø-akha, timbopavat
Yaq khøuwa nøme qandopave, Yesu matavap āv genegó nqǽgo: Gelili plovins-té qatǿnáv. Ate av-té ge꞉mat, yaq ezoqam ndø-omét. Teqa iz Filíp. Yaq āv gembøe-eín nqǽgo, “No qonøndó-páev.”
Filip, ndego Betsaida vemiav-ák. Até Endlu neka Pitá-ya, vemiav kopó.
Yaq Filip Natanael ndø-omét. Gembo-ein, “Ni ndégo tei-ometám, Mozes neka Mbumbukiam-gi manqa vevezam ezoqam gi꞉peaomem, teqa yaq-te. Ndego iz nqambógo, Yesú. Zosef-gé yó. Nazalet vemiav-ák.”
Geté Natanael gendo-ein, “Gê, Nazalet vemiav-te, matev qanimav kopo ndǿfakhan? Géfakhanák.” Yaq Filip gendo-qavøiu, “Qotøndéqāv. Qakeza qó-omét.”
Yesu Natanael ge-omet, gegeavun, yaq teqa yaq-te āv gene-eín nqǽgo, “Ngé! Ngenek unimanqatin Izlael ezoqám. Te mokho-te, khavozam mbaín.”
Yaq Natanael Yesu gembobevap, “Ge qô, no áv khoqotéqateq?” Yaq Yesu gendo-qavøiu, “Filip qo okhokho-té genøqa-eín. No é-møeqamékh, fig tae guzuguzu-te qoqoqotam.”
Yaq Natanael gembo-qavøiu, “Nøméndim ezoqam. Qo unimanqatín Mbumbukiam-gé yó. Qo ni Izlael ezoqam-gé kawá.”
Yaq Yesu gendo-qavøiu, “Qo ndǿgo toqote-unimanqatín, no av qataqambe-ein nqægo, ‘No ē-møeqamēkh, fig tae guzuguzu-te qoqoqotam.’ Geté qo matev uni kandakanda-in nøme ndòqoqeivít.”
Yaq Yesu manqat nøme gembo-ein, “No unimanqatín nqazø-manqate. Zo yan mboqoat zóqeivím. Yaq Mbumbukiam-gi enzol ezoqam segé-vesendát, Ezoqam-ge Yo-te vǿevisīt neka vǿe-qavigīt.”
